run_cosmos_lora_training: run LoRA fine-tuning of Cosmos Predict2.5 video generation model on custom video dataset
create_video_dataset: create a video dataset class that loads videos, captions, and preprocesses frames for training
build_training_dataloader: build a DataLoader from a VideoDataset with configurable batch size and worker count
configure_lora_adapter: configure a LoRA adapter on the DiT transformer with custom rank, alpha, and target modules
sample_training_timestep: sample training timestep from logit-normal distribution for rectified flow velocity prediction
